name: Levi's x Nike Air Max 95 OG 'Light Orewood Brown'
story_html: Launching as part of a collaborative three-piece pack, the Levi's x Nike Air Max 95 OG 'Light Orewood Brown' features an ivory-colored denim upper, complete with frayed edges and signature wavy overlays along the side panel. Air Max branding decorates the tongue, while the classic red Levi's tag accompanies a mini-Swoosh embroidered on the lateral heel. A white polyurethane midsole packs visible Air-sole cushioning for a comfortable ride.
